summary: 2-Minute Calm feature — full backend + frontend e2e testing. 15/15 pytest passed, all UI flows verified (public /calm page, admin /admin/calm, header hamburger nav-calm, wellbeing cross-link). Free preview vs. paywall gating confirmed at both API and UI layers. Paid-user simulation via localStorage unlocks all months as expected.

minor.issue: HEAD requests return 405 Method Not Allowed. FastAPI @router.get by default doesn't accept HEAD. Doesn't affect real UX (browser <audio> uses GET, which returns 200 + audio/mpeg + ~1.9MB), but tools using HEAD for preflight/link-check will fail. Consider adding an explicit HEAD handler or letting Starlette auto-derive HEAD from GET.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): Allow HEAD on /api/calm/{slug}/audio.mp3 (either add explicit HEAD route or use starlette method_not_allowed handling). Not blocking UX.
